the_r1_attempt.what_R1_did_establish: the checkpoint FILE is sound: sixteen keys load with strict=True and are all byte-identical, the actor digest is d4a13ff7..., the critic digest is 2fa9c124..., the log-std slice and sigma are exact, the Adam state holds indices [6..11] which ARE the six critic tensors, all twelve moments are byte-identical and every step is 81.

observed_cause.stop_message: Training STOPPED - PPOConfig.build_algo exceeded the 600 s wall-clock timeout (child self-guard).
observed_cause.the_error: ModuleNotFoundError: No module named 'train_ppo_mlp', raised inside ray/_private/runtime_env/setup_hook.py at pickle.loads(worker_setup_func_info.function); Ray reported 'Worker exit detail: Failed to deserialize the setup hook method.'
the_mechanism: Ray serialises that hook BY REFERENCE to the module that defines it, so every worker must be able to import train_ppo_mlp
Ray workers are fresh processes: they rebuild sys.path from the interpreter and PYTHONPATH, never from the driver's runtime sys.path.insert
the warm-up launched train_ppo_mlp.py directly, so baseline_MLP was sys.path[0] and the workers could import it - hence zero occurrences in its log
operation 4 of the command derivation substitutes the script with the validation-only wrapper, so sys.path[0] became the validation directory
the wrapper adds baseline_MLP to sys.path inside its own process only, and launch_once set only PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE in the child environment
every EnvRunner therefore died, build_algo could never finish, and the child self-guard fired at 600 s
observed_cause.what_this_is_not: it is not a statement about the checkpoint, the optimizer, the configuration, the hardware or the restorability. That code never ran.

the_single_correction.what: launch_once prepends the ABSOLUTE baseline_MLP directory to PYTHONPATH in the environment it hands to the child process.
the_single_correction.where: the R2 runner only, in the environment dictionary passed to subprocess.Popen
rules: the value is the absolute baseline_MLP directory, derived from the runner's own resolved __file__, never a relative path and never a cwd-dependent one
it is PREPENDED, so it wins over any pre-existing entry
any pre-existing PYTHONPATH is PRESERVED VERBATIM after the separator; when there is no pre-existing value no separator is added
the separator is os.pathsep, so the same code is correct on macOS and on Windows
the environment is a COPY of os.environ; the runner's own os.environ is never mutated
fail-closed: the runner refuses to launch if that directory is not absolute or does not contain train_ppo_mlp.py
the_single_correction.why_this_and_nothing_else: it is the minimum that makes the module importable by a fresh worker process. It touches no production file, no configuration, no checkpoint and no gate.

stage_identifier.why_they_differ: so that the R1 architect GO can never authorise R2 and the R2 GO can never authorise R1. validate_go compares the stage exactly, so a mismatched GO is refused rather than silently accepted.

no_automatic_retry.rule: R2 is NOT a retry. It is a separate, separately preregistered, separately authorised single execution.
requirements: R2 runs only under its own architect GO, in its own file, with status exactly APPROVED and stage V26C_J20_RESTORE_AUDIT_R2
no runner may re-launch a child after any outcome; there is exactly one subprocess.Popen and no code path reaches it twice
if R2 fails, there is no R3 without a further architect decision
the R1 leaf is never reused, and the R2 leaf is refused if it already exists

smoke_test.purpose: check the necessary condition that failed, without building an Algorithm, without constructing an environment, without starting Ray and without training anything.
smoke_test.method: two subprocesses whose working directory is the validation directory. The first has no PYTHONPATH and must report that importlib.util.find_spec('train_ppo_mlp') is None. The second is given the environment the R2 runner's own child_environment() builds and must report that find_spec is not None. find_spec RESOLVES a module without executing it, so nothing is imported, nothing is initialised and there is no side effect.
smoke_test.what_it_proves: that the corrected environment makes train_ppo_mlp findable by a fresh interpreter that does not inherit the parent's runtime sys.path - the exact condition whose absence killed every R1 worker.
smoke_test.what_it_does_NOT_prove: that Ray will therefore deserialise the setup hook and that build_algo will complete. That remains a HYPOTHESIS until R2 actually runs. No Ray is started here, deliberately, so that nothing in this preparation can be mistaken for a second audit.
